blocks.h2: When a Slow Drain Needs a Plumber
blocks.body: Call us when the plunger fails, when a drain clogs again soon after you cleared it or when you notice a sewage smell. Then check how far it reaches. If one fixture is slow, the clog is nearby. If the basement floor drain gurgles or fills when the washer empties, the blockage is in the main line, and that calls for [sewer line drain cleaning](/skokie/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

bodies: Hair and soap in bathroom drains, grease and food in kitchen lines, lint from the laundry. We clear clogs with a cable sized for the pipe and show you what came out.

Many Skokie homes still have original galvanized and cast iron drain pipe inside the walls. It narrows with rust and scale over the years, so clogs return faster. If a drain keeps clogging, a camera look tells us whether it's buildup we can clear or pipe that needs replacing.
Kitchen clogs are mostly grease. It coats the inside of the pipe and catches food and soap until water stops moving.

If the other bowl fills or the dishwasher backs up into the sink, the clog is deeper than the trap. We clear the line back to the stack. If the disposal is involved, see [garbage disposal repair](/skokie/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Skokie Homes
blocks.intro: Nearly 2 in 3 Skokie homes were built between 1940 and 1969, and their drains show it.

items.body: Rough, narrowed pipe catches debris quickly.
Lint and soap from the washer clog the tub and floor drain.
Several slow drains at once usually mean the main line. See [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When the floor drain backs up or every fixture slows down, the main sewer drain is blocked. Clearing it means running a machine from the cleanout all the way to the street.

We clear the line and then camera it. In Skokie, the cause is usually roots in old clay or scale in cast iron. If clogs keep coming back, we'll go over the options: [yearly rodding](/skokie/sewer-rodding), [hydro jetting](/skokie/hydro-jetting) or a [sewer repair](/skokie/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: Can you come out for an emergency drain cleaning?
items.answer: Yes. If a drain backs up at night or on a weekend, call us and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why do the drains in my 1950s home clog so often?
items.preview: Old pipe narrows and roughens inside.
items.answer: Original galvanized and cast iron drains build up rust and scale, which catches hair and grease. Jetting or replacing the worst sections helps.

items.q: My kitchen sink and dishwasher both back up. What's wrong?
items.preview: The clog is past the trap.
items.answer: The clog is in the drain line past the trap, often grease. We clear it back to the main stack.

items.q: Should I use a drain cleaner from the store?
items.preview: We'd avoid it on old pipe.
items.answer: We'd avoid it, especially on older pipe. Chemicals rarely clear the whole clog and can damage old drains.

items.q: Why does my basement floor drain gurgle?
items.preview: A partial clog in the main.
items.answer: Usually a partial blockage in the main line. It's a sign to get it cleared soon.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
